tagline.en: Warp-as-History — camera-controlled image-to-video that warps past frames as geometric history for consistent motion.
tagline.zh: Warp-as-History——相机可控的图生视频，把过往帧作为几何历史进行 warp，实现一致的运动。

en: Warp-as-History turns a still image into a video along a camera path you control. Its central idea is to warp already-generated frames forward as a geometric 'history', so the model conditions on where the scene has been and produces coherent, camera-consistent motion.

The system combines a Helios diffusion runtime with a Pi3 geometry module used for camera-pose-to-warp rendering, driven through CLI scripts with the model, LoRA, and Pi3X checkpoints supplied as local assets. In WorldFoundry the official runtime is vendored in-tree.
Because its upstream stack pins specific Python and PyTorch versions, it runs in a dedicated environment profile rather than the shared one.
zh: Warp-as-History 把一张静态图沿你控制的相机路径生成为视频。其核心思想是把已生成的帧向前 warp，作为一段几何“历史”，让模型以场景此前的状态为条件，产出连贯、相机一致的运动。
该系统将 Helios 扩散运行时与用于相机位姿到 warp 渲染的 Pi3 几何模块结合，通过 CLI 脚本驱动，模型、LoRA 与 Pi3X 的 checkpoint 以本地资源提供。在 WorldFoundry 中，官方运行时被内置于代码树。
由于其上游技术栈固定了特定的 Python 与 PyTorch 版本，它在专用环境配置中运行，而非共享环境。

whenToUse.en: Reach for Warp-as-History when you want to animate a single image along a controlled camera trajectory and care about geometric, camera-consistent motion.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让一张图沿受控相机轨迹动起来，并在意几何一致、相机一致的运动时，选择 Warp-as-History。

notFor.en: Runs in a dedicated environment because its stack pins specific Python/PyTorch versions; large checkpoints (Helios, LoRA, Pi3X) must be staged locally first.
notFor.zh: 因技术栈固定了特定 Python/PyTorch 版本，需在专用环境中运行；大型 checkpoint（Helios、LoRA、Pi3X）须先在本地准备好。
